attchmntText: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has notified a change in senior management. Shri Shrirang Anilrao Kothe has been appointed as CEO Helicopter Complex. The effective date of this appointment is 13th November 2026. The company filed this disclosure with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The BSE scrip code is 541154. The NSE symbol is HAL. Shailesh Bansal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited filed its audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone total income from operations was 7,61,311 lakhs, up from 6,62,846 lakhs in the same period last year. Standalone net profit after tax was 1,83,904 lakhs, compared to 1,66,252 lakhs previously. Standalone basic earnings per share was 27.50 rupees. Consolidated total income from operations was 13,12,842 lakhs. Consolidated net profit after tax was 3,52,530 lakhs. Consolidated basic earnings per share was 52.71 rupees. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the results. The company prepared these results in accordance with the Companies Indian Accounting Standards Rules 2015. The full format is available on stock exchange websites and the company website. The statement was signed by Chairman and Managing Director Ravikumar on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- withdrawal
voiceSummary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has withdrawn its credit ratings from ICRA Limited. The withdrawal applies to long-term fund-based limits of Rs. 4,000.00 crore, previously rated AAA with a stable outlook, and short-term non-fund-based limits of Rs. 2,050.00 crore, previously rated A1+. The total facilities withdrawn amount to Rs. 6,050.00 crore. ICRA confirmed the withdrawal was at the company's request, based on No Objection Certificates from bankers. The agency stated it has no information suggesting a change in credit risk since the last review. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulation, 2015. The notice was issued on 11th November, 2026.
